_status_note: No awaiting_payment / scheduled here: those imply payments and service_jobs rows, which the live demo flow creates.

titles: Battery drains in under an hour
descriptions: My laptop battery stopped charging. It stays at 0% even when plugged in overnight.
Battery shows plugged in, not charging. Tried another socket, same thing.
Battery goes from 100 to 0 in about 50 minutes now. It used to last all day.
templates.summary: Battery doesn't hold or take charge; outlet swap didn't help. Battery health check pending.

descriptions: When I plug in the charger nothing happens. No light, no charging icon.
Charger works on my friend's laptop but mine says no adapter connected.
templates.summary: Charger not detected by the laptop; charger works on another device, so suspect the port or board.

titles: Screen is black but laptop is on
descriptions: Laptop turns on, I can hear the fan and see the keyboard light, but the screen stays black.
The screen flickers constantly, worse when I move the lid.
There are vertical green lines across the display since yesterday.
templates.summary: Internal display fault while the system runs; external monitor test pending.

titles: Fans very loud and laptop hot
descriptions: The laptop gets very hot near the keyboard and shuts down during video calls.
Fans are at full speed all the time even when I'm only browsing.
templates.summary: Overheating under light load; vents and power mode checked. Likely needs fan cleaning and repaste.

descriptions: It powers on, shows the logo, and then just keeps spinning forever.
After last night's update it won't start. It goes to automatic repair and fails.
templates.summary: Boot loop at the logo; automatic repair fails. SSD detection in BIOS to be confirmed.

descriptions: I keep getting a blue screen with DRIVER_IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL a few times a day.
Laptop randomly crashes to a blue screen, usually when I'm on Teams.
templates.summary: Recurring BSOD; stop code recorded. Driver rollback and memory test pending.

descriptions: Everything is slow. Opening Chrome takes almost a minute.
Boot takes around five minutes and the disk shows 100% usage.
templates.summary: General slowness with high disk usage; startup apps and free space checked.

descriptions: Wi-Fi disconnects every 10 minutes. My phone on the same network is fine.
Internet keeps dropping on the laptop only, especially on battery.
templates.summary: Intermittent Wi-Fi drops on the laptop only; adapter power saving and driver to be checked.

descriptions: The speakers crackle at any volume. Headphones sound fine.
Sound is distorted and buzzy from the built-in speakers.
templates.summary: Speaker distortion; headphones are clean, so it points to speaker hardware.

descriptions: The E, R and T keys stopped working. Others are fine.
Half the bottom row doesn't respond. No liquid spill.
templates.summary: Several keys unresponsive; BIOS key test and cleaning pending.

descriptions: After the latest Windows update my touchpad does nothing.
Camera app says no camera found since the update yesterday.
templates.summary: Device stopped working after an update; driver rollback suggested.

descriptions: My desktop doesn't turn on at all. No fans, no lights.
Pressed the power button and nothing happens. It was fine yesterday.
templates.summary: No power on the desktop; PSU test pending.

descriptions: Every time I unplug the PC the date goes back to 2020.
BIOS keeps losing my boot order whenever power goes out.
templates.summary: Clock and BIOS settings reset after power loss; likely CMOS battery.

descriptions: The left side of my headphones has stopped playing anything.
Right earbud/earcup is completely silent, left works.
templates.summary: One side silent; balance and source checked. Reset and firmware update pending.

descriptions: Headphones disconnect from my phone every few minutes.
They don't show up in Bluetooth anymore. Tried restarting the phone.
templates.summary: Bluetooth pairing unstable; re-pair and factory reset suggested.

descriptions: The charging light doesn't come on and they're dead.
Battery used to last a day, now only about two hours.
templates.summary: Headphones don't charge or hold charge; cable swap pending.

agent_replies.resolved: Glad that's working again. I'm closing this ticket; reply here if anything comes back.
agent_replies.in_progress: Thanks for the details. I'm looking into this now and will update you shortly.
agent_replies.awaiting_customer: Could you try the steps above and let me know what you see?
